textRuns.value: How to use: the rental chart shows where facility income concentrates and the utilization column shows headroom (S3 monetization prices +15pts of it). S1/S2 are financial-market scenarios at the settings' net return; S4 is cost avoidance with a grant angle. Compare 5-year values AGAINST liquidity and mission columns - never on value alone (the tab-9 framework applies here too).
